summary_points: This document is an instrument specification for a project named Solana.
It includes details on alternate billing cycles and confidentiality agreements.
The scope of work involves supplying instruments, cables, gaskets, etc.
Supplier responsibilities include delivery to designated locations and tracking material purchases.
Confidential information must not be reproduced or disclosed without permission.
Equipment must meet all dimensional, quality, marking, and stamping requirements for NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
Supplier must provide vendor data as promised within the specified timeframe.
Quotation must include time to submit approval drawings and fabrication time after approval.
Equipment must be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations to be released later.
Shipment must adhere to a strict delivery schedule finalized at the time of the final contract, estimated June 2012.
Recommended spare parts list for one year's normal maintenance is required with prices and delivery details.
Equipment subject to inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Vendor invited to quote as an alternate for improvements in price, delivery, or performance.
Specifications prepared using accepted engineering practices and approved technical standards.
Pressure units are measured using glycerine as the fill fluid.
PGV dates include April 2012, March 2012, December 2011, and June 2011.
The document number is 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0002 with revision 3.
Manufacturer: ABENGOA SOLAR ABENER TEYMA.
Manifold material is 316 SS.
All pressure gauges must be calibrated by the vendor.
The process connection uses 3/4" NPT-M and direct mounting.
Instrument tags are specified as 316SS 2" * 4".
The gauge type is Bourdon with a range specified on sheet 6.
The instrument quantity is 22, 22, and 2222.
Pressure gauge specifications for HTF and Molten Salt systems.
HTF gauge has a design pressure of 300 psig and operates at high temperatures.
Molten Salt gauge also has a design pressure of 300 psig but operates at 750°F.
Both gauges use Bourdon tubes with 316 SS materials.
Gauges are calibrated by vendors, requiring certificates of calibration.
Notes include requirements for mounting kits and specific connections.
Issue for Bid section mentions Solana power plant and ABENGOA SOLAR details.
Operational temperature range from 0 to 100°F.
Calibrated pressure range from 0 to 100 psi-g.
Multiple pressure gauges listed for the hot salt electric heater discharge pressure.
Instrument tags include 253-MS-03A-CS31-10" and others.
Document number: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0002, revision 3.
